review.why: Grows a wiki with a budget-capped research loop over web, arXiv and GitHub fetchers, with a kill switch.
review.summary: Driver that pops a seed query, fetches sources through pluggable fetchers, extracts claims, dedupes them against the wiki index, writes or amends a page and queues follow-up seeds. It stops on a cost cap, page or depth cap, convergence or a stop file, and refuses non-local fetchers for private wikis.
strengths: Several stop conditions, including a kill-switch file
Pluggable fetchers with a documented interface
cautions: Builds on other skills (wiki-builder, wiki-query) and a SQLite index
Runs unattended for long periods and spends model tokens
Convergence is a token-overlap heuristic; better dedupe is deferred
